result: Keep the 32-bit counter and synchronous active-high reset unchanged. Replace the `if (counter == 32'd255) counter <= 32'd0; else counter <= counter + 32'd1;` update with an unconditional 32-bit increment whose bit 8 is suppressed only when the current counter equals 255; the other incremented bits already match the required wrapped zero value at that count. Preserve the existing registered `pwm_out <= (counter < {24'd0, duty})` expression and reset behavior; do not narrow the counter or add latency. The expected LUT reduction is modest and must be established by retained routed metrics against the 7-LUT incumbent, with all fixed verification and timing gates passing.
